name: Aichi support robot
full_name: Neuroendovascular intervention support robot with insertion-force sensing (Aichi)
group: Aichi Medical University, Department of Neurosurgery and Neuroendovascular Therapy Center (Shigeru Miyachi) with Aichi University of Technology (Yoshitaka Nagano) and Nagoya City University (T. Hironaka) (miyachi2019_novel affiliations)
versions: 2019 prototype with 2 independent slaves and 2-joystick master (miyachi2019_novel, World Neurosurg 127:e617, full); 2021 remote operation over LAN (miyachi2021_remote, PMC HTML); 2025 review with miniaturised 3D-printed slave and automatic coil insertion (miyachi2025_robotics)
devices_driven: microcatheter (forward/back) and microguidewire (forward/back/twist) at once, by two independent slaves; guiding catheter placed manually (miyachi2019_novel Methods, Fig. 3); coil delivery in the 2025 version (miyachi2025_robotics Fig. 3)
n_dof_detail: 3 (MC translation; MGW translation + rotation) (miyachi2019_novel Slave Manipulator, Fig. 3)
translation_detail: friction-roller: device pinched between two rollers, DC motor through a 523:1 gear, upper roller in an open-close cover; roller grip set to slip above 1 N push (miyachi2019_novel Slave Manipulator, Driving Speed and Safety Function)
rotation_detail: MGW roller unit and force sensor sit inside a drum turned by an engaging roller with a rubber anti-slip belt; battery inside the drum allows 360 deg rotation (miyachi2019_novel Slave Manipulator, Fig. 3); Bluetooth link to its motor in 2021 (miyachi2021_remote)
force_sensing: proximal: push/pull force sensor behind the MGW roller actuator, shown on the monitor in newtons and as a musical tone; repeatability +/-0.04 N (miyachi2019_novel Slave Manipulator, Results, Figs. 4-5); insertion-force sensor in the Y-connector in later versions
haptics_leader: no haptics; two joysticks (left MC, right MGW; tilt left/right advances/withdraws, forward/back twists the MGW, speed proportional to tilt) with audio/visual force display (miyachi2019_novel Master Manipulator)
imaging_compat: X-ray angiography room: clinical simulation on the aneurysm model in a standard AngioSuite with the operator in the control room (miyachi2019_novel Fig. 7)
sterility: slave units are waterproof; electric cords and circuit boards under the supporting frame (miyachi2019_novel Slave design); drape N.R.
validation_detail: bench: > 50 master-slave trials without error motion, force-gauge calibration (miyachi2019_novel Results); phantom: microcatheterisation and aneurysm-sac insertion in a wet EVE silicone whole-vessel model with closed saline circulation under fluoroscopy, repeated AngioSuite trials all successful (Results, Figs. 6-7); remote coiling with the master 50 m away over LAN/HTTP (miyachi2021_remote)
key_numbers: slave output force > 1 N; guidewire speed about 1 mm/s (523:1 gear); slave roller slips above 1 N pushing load (safety); force gauge +/-0.04 N; start-motion lag 0.1-0.2 s (miyachi2019_novel); delays about 0.1 s each for motor stop, Bluetooth, video and network (miyachi2021_remote)
